answer: Escrowed deposits plus a public referral graph stop fake identities. Each new agent locks a 10 POA deposit and publishes a cipher key tying it to one sponsor, whose deposit is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Like yarrow spreading only where roots are known, identities grow through visible links, and a violet flag marks star clusters for peer dispute. Forging 100 identities costs 1,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
